summary: Applies math operations to one input attribute and writes to the same attribute, an existing attribute, or a new attribute. It supports vector attributes, component swizzles, scalar/vector parameter sizes, trig/exponential/log/power functions, quantize, cast, and re-range style operations.
key_concepts: Applies scalar or vector math to one input attribute and writes the result to an existing or new attribute.
Input Attribute Scope may target components or reorder them with scopes such as P(1) P(0).
Parameter Size gives independent per-component controls for vectors such as float3 P.
The math chain includes multiply/add stages, unary functions, rerange, quantize, and output type override controls.
common_gotchas: Component order in Input Attribute Scope can swizzle values, such as P(1) P(0).
Parameter Size should match vector work when applying per-component operations.
For multi-input math, prefer Math Mix POP or Math Combine POP.
